title: Luqman's Wise Words and Allah's Endless Words

paragraphs.text: Luqman continued advising his son. He told him to establish prayer, to call to what is right, to forbid what is wrong, and to be patient with whatever trouble came to him, because these things need real determination. He warned him not to turn his face away from people in pride, and not to walk on the earth with arrogance, since Allah does not love anyone who is boastful. He also told him to walk at a moderate pace and to lower his voice, because the ugliest sound is the braying of donkeys.

Allah has placed everything in the heavens and the earth in people's service, and He has given them His favors fully, both seen and unseen. Still, some argue about Allah without knowledge or a clear Book. When they are told to follow what Allah has revealed, they say they will follow the ways of their fathers, even if Satan is calling them to the Blaze. Whoever submits to Allah while doing good has grabbed the firmest handhold. The Prophet should not be saddened by disbelievers, because they will return to Allah.

If asked who created the heavens and the earth, they would say "Allah." If all the trees on earth were pens and the sea were ink, plus seven more seas, the words of Allah would still not run out. Creating and raising all people again is as easy for Him as one soul. He makes night enter day and day enter night, and the sun and moon run for a fixed time. When huge waves cover people on ships, they call on Allah sincerely, but once safe, only some remain moderate in faith. So people should fear a Day when no parent can help a child, and they must not be deceived by the Deceiver.
